interpretation: Descriptive bounded-agent experiment. No statistical significance or autonomous software-engineering learning claim.

definitions.RepeatedFailureRate: same reproduced exception signature and previously successful training cause / all failed repair attempts; reproduction probes excluded
definitions.MemoryUseRate: runs explicitly citing memory in selection / runs with retrieval
definitions.MemoryUtilityRate: retrieval changed first strategy and action and improved success or iterations vs paired baseline / runs with retrieval
definitions.LearningGain: metric(memory) - metric(NO_MEMORY); negative IterationsPerTask is favorable; null means undefined
definitions.time: wall time is recorded but never used as proof of improvement
definitions.replication: same-seed determinism checks, not independent scientific samples
